# Northline Search

> Evidence-based SEO audits and full-service SEO: full-site crawls, Core Web Vitals, schema, content and E-E-A-T, local SEO and AI search (GEO) readiness, delivered as a prioritized fix plan.

## Services
- [Full SEO Audit](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/#services): full-site crawl, speed tests, schema, content, E-E-A-T and AI search review with PDF report, action plan and CSV issue lists.
- [Audit + Implementation](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/#packages): the audit plus hands-on fixes and a re-crawl to verify them.
- [Ongoing SEO](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/#packages): monthly crawls, Search Console monitoring, content and AI visibility work.

## Proof
- [Case study: Bay Property Management Group (baymgmtgroup.com)](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/case-study/): 4,758 URLs crawled; found pricing placeholders, a sitewide broken phone link, a 15.1 s mobile LCP and AI crawlers blocked at the origin.
